item.title: Japan Institutional Gateway study featured in Medical Xpress
item.description: A study published on the Japan Institutional Gateway exploring the relationships between childhood bullying/domestic violence and insomnia among employees in Japan was recently featured in a Medical Xpress article. item.title: Refreshing the F1000 model: transitioning to editorial-led peer reviewer selection
item.description: Authors will continue to submit their articles through our single-page submission system.
